notes: VCA303 rework #2 (Buyer Due List carry-over): (1) the 'Carry Over' mark is now a darker DIAGONAL 45° stamp at each carry-over point (a non-final column's foot), matching the reference; (2) multi-column buyers get a part-number BADGE (1, 2, 3) on each column banner, replacing the '— தொடர்ச்சி'/'தொடர்கிறது' text; (3) all the columns of one buyer are kept together on the SAME page — a continued account never straddles a page break.
